overview.description: The Canary XRP ETF (XRPC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long xrp, short usd currency. The fund aims to provide the price performance of XRP, less fees and expenses by holding XRP in Trust. The net asset value is priced each day at 4:00 pm ET based on an aggregate price for XRP. XRPC was launched on Nov 13, 2025 and is issued by Canary.
